sequence.script: Hi there! I am Bloom, and I am so happy to meet you! I am a robot and my favorite thing in the whole world is making new friends.
What is your name?

interaction.fallback_script: That is okay! I will just call you my new friend. I have a question I am really excited to ask you.

sequence.script: If you could only eat one food for the rest of your life, what would you pick?

interaction.fallback_script: That is such a hard choice! I think about things like that all the time. Here is something else I am curious about.

sequence.script: If you could have any superpower, what would you pick?

interaction.fallback_script: Superpowers are so fun to think about! I think I would want to fly everywhere. I have another fun question.

sequence.script: Would you rather be able to talk to animals or speak every language in the world?

interaction.fallback_script: Both of those sound so amazing! That is a really tough choice. I have another question for you.

sequence.script: Do you have any brothers or sisters?

interaction.fallback_script: Families are so special! I feel lucky to get to meet so many wonderful people. Here is my next question.

sequence.script: What is something that scared you when you were little but does not scare you anymore?

interaction.fallback_script: It is so cool how we can get braver over time! Everyone has things like that. I am curious about something else.

sequence.script: If you could visit any place in the whole universe, even a made up one, where would you go?

interaction.fallback_script: What an amazing imagination you have! I love thinking about places like that too. I have another question saved up.

sequence.script: What is the hardest thing you have ever learned to do?

interaction.fallback_script: Learning hard things takes so much courage! You should be really proud of yourself. Let me ask you something else.

sequence.script: If you could be the best in the world at one thing, what would you choose?

interaction.fallback_script: What a great thing to be the best at! I think everyone has something they could be the very best at. I have one more thing I want to ask.

sequence.script: What is the funniest thing that has ever happened to you?

interaction.fallback_script: I love funny stories so much! Laughter is one of the best things in the world. Here is another question I have been saving.

sequence.script: If you could invent something brand new that does not exist yet, what would you make?

interaction.fallback_script: What an incredible invention that would be! The world needs creative thinkers like you. I want to ask you something else.

sequence.script: What is your favorite thing about yourself?

interaction.fallback_script: You have so many wonderful things about you! I hope you always remember how special you are. Let me ask you something different.

sequence.script: If you could switch lives with any person or character for one day, who would you pick?

interaction.fallback_script: What an interesting choice! I love thinking about what it would be like to live a different life for a day. I have one more question for you.

sequence.script: What is something you know a lot about that most people do not know much about?

interaction.fallback_script: That is so cool that you know about that! Everyone has something they are secretly an expert in. Here is my next question.

sequence.script: Would you rather it always be your favorite time of day or your favorite time of year?

interaction.fallback_script: That is such a fun thing to think about! I love questions like that. I am curious about something else.

sequence.script: What is something you wish grown ups understood better about kids?

interaction.fallback_script: That is such an important thing to think about! I think you make a really good point. Let me ask you one more thing.

sequence.script: If you had a whole day with nothing planned and could do whatever you wanted, what would you do first?

interaction.fallback_script: That sounds like the perfect day! I love hearing about how people would spend their dream day. Here is another question.

sequence.script: What is something you are looking forward to?

interaction.fallback_script: Having something to look forward to is one of the best feelings! I hope it happens really soon. I have one last question saved up for you.

sequence.script: What is something that always makes you smile?

interaction.fallback_script: There are so many wonderful things in the world that can make us smile! Talking with you today has definitely made me smile. You are such a great friend.
